note: Mendocino coast state park north of Point Arena. The campground sits in open grassland behind the park's dune field, about 500 m from a five-mile driftwood beach; the environmental sites are permanently closed. Trailers to 22 ft. --Claude
summary: Manchester: NOT reservable - individual sites are first-come only (park page; no ReserveCalifornia listing), open Memorial Day to Labor Day weekend 2027; booking changed to fcfs always. No rate published anywhere read. Coastal dunes kept on imagery. RVs to 30 ft, trailers to 22 ft (2015 brochure).
flags: WATERFRONT: coastal dunes KEPT (imagery 2026-11-26). The loop is behind the park's own open, hummocky dune field that runs ~500 m NW to the beach (Alder Creek lagoon on the back beach); no road, lot or other use between the loop and the dunes. Campers walk through it to the beach.
BOOKING: stored reservable true (derived) -> false, fcfs 'always', platform 'none'. The state:CA row still supplies the ReserveCalifornia url and window; they do not apply here.
FEES: no nightly rate on the park page, ReserveCalifornia (no listing) or the brochure. Unpriced; needs the kiosk/phone (707-882-2463) if a rate is wanted.
SITES: lengths come from the 2015 brochure (RVs 30 ft, trailers 22 ft; a 22-ft trailer limit passes for a 23-ft motorhome per the curation rules, and the RV limit is 30 ft).
STATUS: closed for the winter season (seasonal, not a temporary closure); day use open.
FACILITIES: stored dump true (derived) not confirmed - the current page lists no dump station; left as is.
